name: Jamnagar Bandhani Pure Silk Dupatta
craftStory: Handcrafted in Jamnagar using ancient resist-dyeing traditions. Master craftsmen pinch fine silk into thousands of micro-dots tied with cotton thread before dipping in natural organic dyes.
pattern: Ekdali & Shikari Pinpoint Dot Motifs
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store wrapped in pure unbleached cotton muslin.

name: Kutch Ajrakh Hand Block Printed Modal Shawl
craftStory: A 16-stage resist block printing technique practiced by the Khatri community of Kutch. Deep crimson and indigo shades derived from madder root, pomegranate rinds, and fermented iron scrap.
materials: Pure Modal Silk & Natural Mineral Dyes
pattern: Star Geometric Jaal & Mughal Border
careInstructions: Gentle hand wash with cold water and soapnut (Reetha). Dry in shade.

name: Jaipur Blue Pottery Hand-Glazed Floral Vase
craftStory: Unique no-clay ceramic craft of Jaipur made from ground quartz stone, Fuller's earth, and Katira gum. Hand-painted with Persian cobalt blue and turquoise glazes fired in traditional charcoal kilns.
materials: Quartz Powder, Glass, Egyptian Copper Oxide Glaze
pattern: Persian Arabesque & Lotus Petals
careInstructions: Wipe with damp microfiber cloth. Do not soak in hot water.

name: Mithila Madhubani Tree of Life Canvas Painting
craftStory: Created by women artists of Mithila using bamboo nib pens and fingers. Hand-drawn double outline with vibrant natural dyes depicting fertility, nature harmony, and Vedic lore.
materials: Handmade Lokta Paper, Soot, Turmeric, Indigo Dyes
pattern: Kachni Fine Hatching & Bharni Colored Motifs
careInstructions: Keep away from direct high-intensity sunlight. Frame behind UV glass.

name: Varanasi Katan Silk Handwoven Royal Saree
craftStory: Woven on traditional pit-looms in the lanes of Varanasi. Two master weavers spend 20 to 30 days crafting this masterpiece with pure gold and silver dipped zari threads.
materials: 100% Pure Mulberry Silk & Real Silver-Gilt Zari
pattern: Jangla Floral Vines & Mughal Kalka Buta
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Roll in muslin cloth; refold periodically to prevent crease wear.

name: Kashmir Handspun Pashmina Shawl with Sozni Needlework
craftStory: Spun from delicate underfleece of Changthangi mountain goats grazing above 14,000 feet. Hand-loomed in Srinagar and delicately hand-embroidered with micro-Sozni needlework over 3 months.
pattern: Hashidar Paisley Border with Fine Sozni Needlepoint
careInstructions: Professional dry clean only. Store with natural cedar balls.

name: Channapatna Wooden Heritage Toy Train & Animals
craftStory: Crafted in Karnataka's Gombegala Ooru (Toy Town) using seasoned soft ivory-wood. Hand-turned on lathes and coated with completely safe, child-friendly vegetable dyes and tree lac resin.
materials: Wrightia Tinctoria (Aale Mara) Wood & Natural Lacquer
pattern: Turned Cylinders with Natural Polish
careInstructions: Wipe with dry soft cloth. Avoid direct water exposure.

name: Assam Braided Golden Bamboo Planter & Storage Basket
craftStory: Handwoven from mature Assam golden bamboo (Bhaluka) split into paper-thin flexible strips. Naturally smoked over wood fire for moisture and pest resistance, ensuring decades of durability.
materials: Indigenous Seasoned Assam Golden Bamboo & Wild Cane
pattern: Diagonal Hexagonal Interlocking Weave
careInstructions: Wipe clean with moist sponge. Keep in well-ventilated space.

name: Palghar Warli Tribal Canvas Art Painting
craftStory: An archaic art form dating to 3000 BCE created by the Warli tribe in the Sahyadri foothills. Handcrafted using white rice paste pigment on mud-plastered fabric canvas, depicting the sacred Tarpa dance.
materials: Natural Rice Paste, Tree Gum & Geru Ochre Fabric Canvas
pattern: Tarpa Spiral Dance & Mother Earth Symbols
careInstructions: Dust gently with dry brush. Keep away from humid bathrooms.

name: Bastar Lost-Wax Dokra Bell Metal Figurine
craftStory: Cast using the primitive lost-wax technique dating back to the Dancing Girl of Mohenjo-Daro. Pure beeswax threads are wrapped around river clay molds and replaced by molten bell metal in pit furnaces.
materials: Recycled Brass, Bronze, Pure Beeswax & Riverbed Clay
pattern: Tribal Musician with Folk Trumpet & Antlers
careInstructions: Clean with dry brass polishing cloth. Maintain antique patina.

name: Srikalahasti Hand-Painted Kalamkari Cotton Fabric
craftStory: Authentic pen-crafted Kalamkari drawn with tamarind twig pens (kalam) on milk-bleached cotton. Colored with pure vegetal pigments derived from myrobalan nuts, madder, and pomegranate.
pattern: Tree of Abundance with Peacocks & Floral Vistas
careInstructions: Cold gentle wash with mild natural detergent. Iron inside out.

name: Bidriware Pure Silver Inlay Black Metal Vase
craftStory: Historic 500-year-old Bahmani metallurgical craft of Bidar. Cast in a zinc-copper alloy, hand-chiseled with pure 99.9% fine silver wire, and patinated to lustrous jet-black using historic Bidar fort soil.
pattern: Tarkashi Geometric Floral Vines
careInstructions: Rub periodically with coconut oil on soft cloth to maintain sheen.

name: Patan Patola Double Ikat Mulberry Silk Saree
craftStory: The pinnacle of Indian weaving art. Both warp and weft yarns are meticulously tie-dyed before weaving on inclined rosewood looms. Both sides are completely identical and the colors never fade for centuries.
pattern: Nari Kunjar (Women & Elephant) Royal Heritage Grid
careInstructions: Cherish as an heirloom. Dry clean only; wrap in unstarched cotton.

name: Lucknow Hand-Embroidered Pure Cotton Chikankari Kurta
craftStory: Originating in the royal Awadhi courts of Lucknow, Chikankari embodies sheer elegance. Hand-stitched by skilled women artisans using 32 delicate traditional needlework stitches including Bakhiya and Phanda.
materials: Fine Mulmul Cotton with Cotton Thread Embroidery
pattern: Bakhiya Shadow Work with Jaali & Floral Bootas
careInstructions: Gentle hand wash inside out. Line dry in shade.
dimensions: Available in M, L, XL, XXL (Standard Indian Fit)

name: Bankura Terracotta Panchmura Heritage Horse
craftStory: The national symbol of Indian handicrafts. Recognized for its proud erect ears, long slender neck, and symmetrical hand-molded body thrown on traditional wooden potter wheels in Bankura.
materials: Alluvial Riverbed Clay & Natural Wood-Fired Ochre
pattern: Fluted Mane & Ceremonial Saddle Applique
careInstructions: Clean with dry soft brush. Protect from severe drops.

name: Thanjavur 22K Gold Leaf Embossed Sacred Icon
craftStory: Originating in the 16th century Maratha courts of Thanjavur. Teakwood base layered with limestone gesso relief, embedded with sparkling Jaipur stones and gilded with 22-karat gold foil leaves.
materials: Teak Wood, Limestone Paste, Jaipur Semi-Precious Stones & 22K Gold Leaf
pattern: Lord Ganesha seated under Floral Temple Arch
careInstructions: Enclosed in glass frame. Wipe front glass with dry microfibre cloth.

name: Kashmir Handcrafted Papier Mache Lacquered Box
craftStory: Brought to Kashmir in the 14th century by Sufi saint Mir Sayyid Ali Hamadani. Formed from mashed paper pulp, hardened, polished with jade stone, and miniature-painted with single-hair cat hair brushes.
materials: Recycled Paper Pulp, Natural Lacquer & Gold Dust Paints
pattern: Gul-andar-Gul (Flower within Flower) & Kingfisher Motif
careInstructions: Dust with dry soft cloth. Keep away from water and direct heat.

name: Chanderi Handloom Pure Silk Zari Tissue Saree
craftStory: Revered since the Vedic era for its gossamer lightness and radiant sheer texture. Handwoven by interlacing fine un-degummed silk warp with fine cotton weft and lustrous silver-gold border work.
materials: Pure Mulberry Silk Warp, Fine Cotton Weft & Metallic Zari
pattern: Ashrafi Gold Coin Bootis with Nakshi Border
careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Store hanging or softly rolled.

name: Odisha Hand-Etched Talapatra Palm Leaf Scroll
craftStory: Seasoned palmyra palm leaves sewn together with cotton thread. The master artist incises delicate mythological episodes with an iron stylus and rubs carbon soot paste into the groves.
materials: Cured Palmyra Palm Leaf & Natural Lamp Black Pigment
pattern: Gita Govinda & Dashavatara Incised Panels
careInstructions: Keep dry and away from damp spaces. Handle with clean dry hands.

name: Pochampally Telia Rumal Handwoven Silk Saree
craftStory: Famous for its intricate geometric precision. The warp and weft yarns are bound and dyed with oil-treated natural pigments before being matched to millimeter accuracy on wooden pit-looms.
materials: Pure Handspun Mulberry Silk & Natural Alizarin
pattern: Square Grid Telia Rumal Geometric Medallions
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Air out periodically in indirect room breeze.

name: Kerala Balaramapuram Kasavu Pure Cotton Saree
craftStory: The traditional ceremonial dress of God's Own Country. Handwoven on throw-shuttle pit looms using unbleached organic cotton yarn bordered with radiant pure metallic gold kasavu threads.
pattern: Temple Kara Border & Elegant Pallu Lines
careInstructions: Gentle hand wash with mild baby shampoo. Starch lightly if desired.

name: Kullu Pure Wool Geometric Border Shawl
craftStory: Handwoven on pit looms in the Pir Panjal mountains using pure indigenous sheep and Angora wool. Famous for its vibrant multicolored geometric borders inspired by Buddhist and Himalayan folklore.
pattern: Multi-Colored Geometric Central Border & Edges
careInstructions: Dry clean or very gentle cold wool wash. Lay flat on towel to dry.

name: Sanganeri Hand Block Printed Cotton Razai Quilt
craftStory: World-famous Jaipur Razai crafted by the Chipa community. Pure mulmul cotton printed with intricate botanical wooden blocks and filled with feather-light carded surgical cotton for cozy insulation.
materials: Pure 100% Mulmul Cotton & Carded Natural Cotton Fluff
pattern: Jaipur Bel-Booti & Floral Jaal on White Ground
careInstructions: Dry clean preferred. Sun-air periodically for natural freshness.

name: Dindori Gond Tribal Narrative Art Canvas
craftStory: Painted by Pardhan Gond tribal masters of central India. Each artist creates unique signature textures composed of delicate dots and dashes celebrating sacred trees, birds, and forest lore.
pattern: Sacred Mahua Tree with Flying Deers & Hornbills
careInstructions: Keep away from moisture and direct UV sunlight. Glass frame recommended.

name: Cuttack Tarakasi Pure 99.9% Silver Filigree Brooch
craftStory: The 500-year-old delicate metal art of Cuttack. Pure silver is hand-drawn through metal dies into gossamer micro-wires, curled into exquisite leaf and peacock spirals, and micro-soldered without seams.
pattern: Royal Mayura Peacock with Openwork Lace Feathers
careInstructions: Store in anti-tarnish velvet pouch. Clean with dry silver cloth.
